text:
Priya: Legal wants auth/session logs "available for audit" for 24 months. We currently keep 90d raw + 1y redacted. Need a concise operational pattern: archive location, KMS separation, JIT unwrap flow, RBAC, and replay throttles.

Marcus: Quick sketch: move 90-730d to cold archive bucket encrypted with 'archive-cmk'. No raw access by default. Access only via ticketed JIT unwrap that mints ephemeral decrypt tokens.

Ellen: Ops notes: large restores spike SIEM ingest. Default replay throttle 400 ev/s per tenant. Require SRE coordination for >1M events and manifest/batch exports for >2M. Connector must honor 429 and exponential backoff. Tag jobs with ticket id + cost-center.

Priya: Audit & key policy: only unwrap-service principal can kms:Decrypt for 'archive-cmk' and must include ticket_id condition. Persist unwrap audit (requestor, approvers, token id, objects, bytes) to immutable audit-bucket for 5y.

Marcus: RBAC proposal: roles 'archive_requester' (open ticket), 'archive_approver' (approve), 'archive_executor' (run unwrap). Day-to-day analysts => 'search_redacted' only. Grants require ticket link + MFA + approver.

security-bot: TASK-6619 created: "24mo auth archive access pattern" assigned to Priya. (automated)

oncall-sre: Add runbook ops: default replay throttle 400 ev/s, off-peak scheduling for >500k events, auto-queue for jobs exceeding throttle, and auto-pause if SIEM connector 5xx/429 rate >5%.

Priya: Minimal CLI examples:
```
/archivereq --tenant=acme --start=2023-01-01 --end=2023-06-01 --purpose="audit"
/archapprove REQ-6619 --approver=ellen --mfa=true
```
On approval: mint ephemeral unwrap token TTL=4h scoped to ticket and manifest. Return presigned GETs TTL=15m or stream to SIEM with rate-limit hooks.

Ellen: Implementation notes: prefer presigned URLs (15m) logged to audit-bucket. Use S3 Select / object-store filters to avoid decrypting whole objects when possible. For >2M events force manifest + staged export.

Priya: Action items:
- Priya: draft KMS key policy + audit schema (due 2025-02-05)
- Marcus: RBAC RFC + ticket template (due 2025-01-28)
- Ellen: add replay throttle + manifest gating to runbook and test harness (due 2025-01-24)
